title: Itaewon Class
hook: How does Itaewon Class end? Sae-ro-yi's revenge on Jangga, the kidnapping climax, and the love he finally admits in the finale, explained.

sections.heading: DanBam becomes IC Group
sections.body: The finale completes Park Sae-ro-yi's long climb from a single Itaewon pub to a corporate empire. By 2020 his business has grown into IC Group, with Sae-ro-yi installed as its CEO. The friends who started the journey at DanBam rise with him: Jo Yi-seo becomes the company's chief financial officer, and the rest of the DanBam staff are made directors. The transformation pays off the show's central promise, that a man who refused to compromise his principles could still beat a giant conglomerate on its own terms, turning a tiny street-corner bar into a rival capable of swallowing the company that ruined his life.

sections.heading: Jangga falls and Dae-hee kneels
sections.body: Sae-ro-yi's revenge against Chairman Jang Dae-hee finally lands. By 2020 Dae-hee is diagnosed with pancreatic cancer and told he does not have long to live, while his illegal dealings are exposed and Jangga Group collapses around him. Brought to ruin, the once-untouchable chairman kneels before Sae-ro-yi to beg for help. Sae-ro-yi answers not with mercy but with finality: he absorbs Jangga into his own company, leaving Dae-hee with nothing. The man who humiliated and destroyed Sae-ro-yi's father is left stripped of his empire, his power, and his pride in a single move.

sections.heading: The kidnapping climax
sections.body: The story's last burst of danger comes from Jang Geun-won, Dae-hee's eldest son, the man whose hit-and-run killed Sae-ro-yi's father. After being released on parole, Geun-won schemes to take revenge on Jo Yi-seo by kidnapping both her and his own brother. The plot becomes the emergency that forces the finale's emotional turn, but it ultimately fails. Geun-won is caught and sentenced to incarceration once again, sent back behind bars without ever landing his revenge. The threat that has shadowed Sae-ro-yi since the first episode is finally neutralised for good.

sections.heading: Sae-ro-yi chooses Yi-seo
sections.body: With the empire won and the enemies beaten, the finale closes on the romance the series had circled for years. Spurred by the danger of the kidnapping, Sae-ro-yi finally recognises his own feelings for Jo Yi-seo and confesses his love to her, ending up with the manager who had devoted herself to him and his cause. Around them the other arcs settle: Oh Soo-ah, his first love, had turned whistle-blower on Jangga's crimes and later opens her own restaurant. The vow of a free, principled life Sae-ro-yi made over his father's grave is fully realised.

final_image: Park Sae-ro-yi, now head of IC Group with Jangga absorbed and his enemies broken, finally confesses his love to Jo Yi-seo.

lingering_questions.q: Who does Park Sae-ro-yi end up with?
lingering_questions.a: Jo Yi-seo. After the kidnapping crisis, Sae-ro-yi realises his feelings and confesses his love to her. His first love, Oh Soo-ah, turns whistle-blower against Jangga and later opens her own restaurant.

lingering_questions.q: What happens to Jang Dae-hee and Jangga Group?
lingering_questions.a: Dae-hee is diagnosed with terminal pancreatic cancer and his crimes are exposed, collapsing Jangga. When he kneels to beg for help, Sae-ro-yi absorbs Jangga into IC Group, leaving him with nothing.
